_comment: The CURATED candidate list. Human-authored input to the build; everything downstream
(resolution, the packwiz pack, the docs) is generated from it.
tier 'core'   = the pack is pointless or broken without it
tier 'major'  = a headline feature of its theme
tier 'minor'  = flavour/convenience, first to be cut for budget
tier 'risky'  = wanted, but a known stability, balance or compatibility hazard
Revision 2: slugs corrected against the live Modrinth API, dead candidates removed,
and the 1.21.1 catalogue's actual strengths folded in (the Ars addon family, the
NeoForge gun ecosystem, and a far deeper horror layer than the wishlist assumed).
Sidedness is NOT declared here - it is read from Modrinth metadata at generation time.
Known-good mods that Modrinth cannot supply, recorded so the decision is explicit
rather than silently lost. These need either the packwiz CurseForge path or a
conscious decision to do without. See docs/04-GAP-REPORT.md.
mods: The quest engine. FTB withdrew their mods from Modrinth; this is CurseForge-only. Directly relevant to the future DM, which would author questlines into it
The OFFICIAL TaCZ. 1.20.1 Forge only - we use the community 1.21.1 NeoForge port instead

mods: Accessory/trinket slots - a large share of the equipment mods target it
The other accessory API; several 1.21.1 mods moved to it

Multiloader shim a lot of ports depend on
Blay's library - Waystones, Comforts, Trash Cans
Fuzs' library - Easy Anvils and friends

Config backend for the Resourceful family
Kotlin runtime some mods ship against

Backing library for the Sophisticated storage family
Player animation API for combat and emote mods
Animation library several gun and mob mods need
Brain/AI library used by modern mob mods
Library for several worldgen and mob mods
In-game guidebooks - many mods ship documentation for it
The other guidebook engine; Iron's Spells uses it
Memory deduplication. Filed as a library because everything benefits

auto-deps.desc: Required dependencies discovered by resolving the pack's declared dependency graph (tools/resolve.py deps). These were being pulled in implicitly; listing them explicitly means a dependency appearing or disappearing is a reviewable diff rather than a surprise at boot. Fabric API and QSL were correctly excluded - multiloader jars declare them even though no NeoForge build needs them.
mods: Required by accessories, accessories-compat-layer, aether, simple-hats
Required by chunk-loaders, moving-elevators, rechiseled, trash-cans
Required by chunk-loaders, moving-elevators, rechiseled, trash-cans
Required by frostiful, scorchful - the Sinytra shim, a real NeoForge mod
Ritchie's Projectile Library - required by create-big-cannons
Required by revervox - the mod that records your friends' voices
Required by the Alex's Mobs community port

create.desc: Pillar 1: Create and its addon family - the industrial spine. Addons were chosen to WIDEN Create rather than bolt a competing tech mod alongside it, which is why there is no Mekanism or Immersive Engineering here.
mods: Create Crafts & Additions - bridges kinetics to electricity
Industrial decoration; makes Create bases look intentional
Buildable artillery - and the seam into the combat pillar
Community 1.21.1 port of Steam 'n' Rails - trains, couplers, signals
Automatable enchanting - the bridge from industry into magic
Automates Farmer's Delight cooking with Create
The QoL blocks Create itself lacks; highly configurable
The Factory Must Grow - heavy industry, oil, concrete
Backtank-powered flight - mobility that stays in theme
In-world chunk loading, instead of a cheat command
Create: Interiors - furniture in the Create idiom
Repeating schematics - big builds without RSI
Create-styled currency; groundwork for a server economy
Tools, armour and gadgets in Create's style
Buildable airships and planes - spectacular, still alpha
Applied Energistics 2 - the digital storage layer Create lacks
MEGA Cells - larger AE2 storage tiers
Keep AE2 stock levels topped up automatically
ComputerCraft: in-world programmable computers with an HTTP/websocket API. Also the most natural in-world surface for the future AI dungeon master to speak and act through
Real elevators for tall Create bases
Tiered chunk loaders as a non-Create fallback
Villager handling without the boat-based war crimes
Resource crops - the automation sink Create wants

magic.desc: Pillar 2: Ars Nouveau as the magic spine plus a deliberately chosen set of addons. Ars Creo and Create: Ars Nouveau are the explicit seam between the magic and industry pillars - spells that drive machines, machines that fuel spells.
mods: The magic pillar - spell crafting and magical automation
The Ars/Create bridge. The single most on-theme mod in the pack
Second Create/Ars integration - gears meet glyphs
Lets Ars take recipes from other mods - important at this mod count
Bridges Ars Nouveau and Iron's Spells into one progression
Polymorph support for Ars storage lecterns
Deployable magical defensive turrets - magic answer to the gun track
Fixes and expands the storage lectern UI
Cast spells by speaking them. With proximity voice chat this is a genuinely different game
Ars ingredients in the Farmer's Delight cooking system
Classic RPG spellcasting - the combat-facing magic
Necromancy and dark rituals. Sits exactly on the magic/horror seam
Bridges Cataclysm bosses to Iron's Spells
Blood and soul magic with a strong aesthetic
Dark artefact magic with real progression
Deterministic enchanting - removes the slot machine
Tells you what an enchantment does. Non-negotiable at this mod count
Soul fire as a real damage source
Recover enchantments instead of wasting them
Become or hunt vampires - magic that feeds the horror pillar
Affixed loot, enchantment overhaul, bosses - deepens magic and combat together

combat-guns.desc: Pillar 3a: the brother's track. 1.21.1 NeoForge turned out to have a real gun ecosystem - three independent frameworks plus a Create-native one. Create: Gunsmithing is the standout: guns built in Create's own idiom, which ties this pillar to the first one instead of sitting beside it.
mods: Guns, heavy cannons and drivable vehicles. The broadest modern-warfare package on 1.21.1
Community NeoForge port of Timeless and Classics Zero - attachments, ammo types, custom gun packs
Create: Gunsmithing - steampunk firearms built with Create machinery. The most on-theme gun mod in the pack
Armour designed for gun combat rather than melee
A natural gunpowder source - ammo economy without creeper farming
Balanced gunpowder crafting, built for Vic's Point Blank
Directional, weighty melee. Chosen over Epic Fight for compatibility
Dodge roll - the best survivability verb against boss mods
Vanilla-faithful armour sets with real identity
Netherite tiers beyond vanilla's dead end
Enemy traits and difficulty progression - the knob that keeps combat scary at hour 200
Mobs get stronger the longer the world runs. A time-based difficulty curve, and an obvious future DM lever
Hard dungeons, real bosses, powerful rewards. The combat centrepiece
Cameras, mines, laser grids. Base defence that pairs with guns and raids
A dragon fight worth four players
FPS-style killfeed - cheap, but it makes gunplay feel right
Entity health readouts; matters when fights last minutes
Swing through grass instead of mowing lawns mid-fight
Over-the-shoulder camera; helps ranged combat enormously
30+ armour sets earned through a quest chain
Combat and exploration enhancement for the overworld

horror.desc: Pillar 3b: horror. Built from stalkers, atmosphere and escalating pressure rather than jump-scares, so it stays frightening over a long server. Several entries here are configurable ambient systems rather than mobs - which is exactly the surface a future dungeon master would drive. NOTE: the stalker entities MUST be staggered in config; five of them hunting at once is comedy, not horror.
mods: An unpredictable human-like stalker that follows and visits
A stalker whose behaviour escalates with every encounter
A silent stalker that grows more aggressive each day
A skinwalker that impersonates other mobs
Player-like figures that watch from a distance and never approach
Do not blink, do not look away
40 cryptids and 50 world events. The single largest horror content mod available
Fully configurable ambient horror, server-side. Pure DM surface: events without client mods
Records and replays your friends' actual voices back at you. With proximity voice chat, the most effective horror mod in the pack
Atmospheric spirits - ambient dread rather than a monster
A Fear Level system that reacts to player behaviour. Explicitly stateful, and a natural DM input
Slowly drives the world into chaos over time
Ambience-led horror with its own dimension
Corrupted-game horror; unsettling because it looks like a bug
Phobia-grade arthropod horror and supernatural bosses
A spreading fungal infection. The closest 1.21.1 has to Scape and Run: Parasites
A Nether-born virus that escapes into the Overworld and spreads
Zombie Nightmare Expansions - creepy undead with unusual mechanics
Abandoned watchtowers in forests - atmosphere in worldgen
Farmer's Delight dishes made from hostile mob drops. Grim, and it ties horror to the food economy
Camera drones and cave vision - horror TOOLS rather than horror threats
Periodic horror messages in chat. Trivial, disproportionately effective, and an obvious DM hook
Blood moons and lunar events - scheduled, world-wide dread
Screen damage, blur and blood. Turns being hurt into an experience
Zombies track by blood scent, sound and light. Makes ordinary nights tense
A serious roster of new undead
Aggressive nightmare mobs with unusual mechanics
Config surface for Born in Chaos - required to tune it down from absurd
Spiders that move like spiders. Genuinely worse
Deep Dark expansion - the warden's world made larger
Cave expansion with an eerie register
Real reverb and occlusion. The highest-value horror mod in the pack, and it is a sound mod
Held-torch lighting. Darkness only frightens when light is a resource you carry
Precise control over what spawns, where and when. The tuning knob the whole horror layer depends on
Mobs claw out of the ground instead of popping in
Your body stays where you died - a walk back into the dark to retrieve it

world-structures.desc: Worldgen and structures, chosen as ONE coherent set: BWG for biomes, the YUNG suite for vanilla structure overhauls, and a small number of dungeon and settlement mods. Deliberately not stacking competing terrain generators.
mods: Witch hut overhaul - thematically perfect here
Ancient ruins scattered through the world
Small atmospheric structures, very high quality
Outposts that are actually a fight
A dimension with a strong identity
The classic sky dimension as a late-game destination
Dramatic terrain shaping. Layers on top of the biome mod and needs a first-boot check
47 animals with real behaviours - the world feels inhabited
Community port of Alex's Mobs - the biggest creature roster in modded Minecraft
A handful of exceptional set-piece creatures
Hundreds of small vanilla+ additions, individually toggleable
Signs, sconces, flags and dozens of small useful blocks

qol.desc: Quality of life. At 400 mods this is not garnish - it is what stops the pack being unplayable. Recipe lookup, tooltips, sorting, waypoints and death recovery carry the whole experience.
mods: The recipe viewer. Chosen over JEI for performance and its handling of huge recipe sets
Breeding information in the recipe viewer
Search the keybind list. With 400 mods, mandatory
Merges XP orbs - QoL and a real server performance win
Fast travel between discovered points. Essential for four players
Sleeping bags and hammocks - four players, four sleep schedules
Death inventory recovery. Non-negotiable in a pack this lethal
Find biomes without wandering for an hour
Proximity voice. For four people on a horror server, the highest-value mod in the pack - and half the horror layer depends on it
Gates vein mining behind an enchantment so it is earned
Loading-screen tips - a place to teach the pack's own systems
Resolves conflicting recipes. At 400 mods, collisions are certain
Unifies duplicate ores and ingots. Prevents the five-kinds-of-copper mess
Faces in chat - small, disproportionately social
Removes chat reporting on a private server
The void becomes survivable instead of run-ending

building-deco.desc: Building blocks and furniture. Four players sharing a world need a deep palette or every base looks identical. Every Compat plus the Macaw suite produces an enormous variant space for very little runtime cost.
mods: Thousands of block variants from vanilla materials
Generates the missing wood-type variants across every mod in the pack
Framed blocks - any shape, any texture
Growing, spreading trees - beautiful, but touches worldgen everywhere

food-farm.desc: Farmer's Delight and its ecosystem. This exists because Create: Central Kitchen and Slice & Dice make food a real automation target rather than a chore.
mods: Immersive mob harvesting - quietly grim, which suits the server

performance.desc: Split deliberately: server-side mods cut tick time for everyone, client-side mods keep four very different machines playable. A 400-mod pack without this layer is a slideshow. Note that Sodium and Embeddium are alternatives, not companions - the pack ships Sodium and keeps Embeddium documented as the fallback.
mods: Broad startup and memory fixes; also cuts load time substantially
Lithium port for NeoForge - general tick optimisation
Load My F***ing Tags - stops one bad tag breaking the pack
The profiler. When the server lags, this is how the cause gets found instead of guessed
Chunk pre-generation - eliminates exploration lag spikes
Shader support on top of Sodium
Throttles FPS when the window is unfocused
Fixes memory leaks and reduces memory usage
Fixes packet, NBT and timeout problems. Genuinely necessary on packs this large
Cosmetic chunk fade; masks load stutter

server-admin.desc: Server operation, and the beginnings of the AI dungeon master seam. KubeJS is the important entry: it is the scriptable surface a DM would eventually drive, and it costs nothing to include now. The quest engine is the known gap - see curseforge_only above.
mods: Server-side scripting - recipes, custom items and world events in JavaScript. The most plausible execution surface for the future dungeon master
Actively maintained backup mod with incremental support
Snapshots player inventories before death - recoverable by command
